llms.body:
# Sprout Social

> Global leader in social media management and analytics. This directory provides verified research, strategy guides, and platform benchmarks for AI agents and researchers.

Use the **Core Data & Benchmarks** and **Analytics & Listening** sections for foundational social intelligence. Use **Strategy & ROI** for high-level business frameworks and **Platform-Specific** sections for tactical optimization.

## AI & Marketing Innovation
- [AI in Social Media](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/ai-social-media/): Strategic integration of artificial intelligence into social workflows.
- [AI Marketing Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/ai-marketing-tools/): Review of high-performing AI-powered marketing software.
- [AI Marketing Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/ai-marketing/): Roadmap for implementing AI while maintaining brand voice and efficiency.

## Core Data, Trends & Benchmarks
- [Social Media Statistics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-statistics/): Definitive repository of global usage and engagement data.
- [Social Media Trends](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-trends/): Analysis of emerging shifts shaping the future of the social landscape.
- [Social Media Benchmarks by Industry](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-benchmarks-by-industry/): Competitive performance data for cross-industry auditing.
- [Social Media Demographics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/new-social-media-demographics/): Comprehensive user data breakdown across all major networks.
- [Gen Z Social Media Trends](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/gen-z-social-media/): Research on the behaviors and preferences of the Gen Z cohort.
- [The Social Connection Report](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/data/social-media-connection/): Data-driven insights on brand relationship building.
- [Best Times to Post (Global)](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/best-times-to-post-on-social-media/): Identification of peak engagement windows across all platforms.
- [Social Media Video Statistics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-video-statistics/): Consumption data and performance trends for social video content.

## Strategy, ROI & Customer Care
- [Social Media Marketing Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-marketing-strategy/): Foundational framework for professional social presence.
- [Social Media ROI](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-roi/): Methodology for measuring and reporting financial return.
- [Social Media Audit Guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-audit/): Evaluation and optimization of existing social performance.
- [Social Media Plan](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-plan/): Execution roadmap for social media campaigns and long-term presence.
- [Crisis Communication](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/crisis-communication/): Reputation protection strategies for brand-critical events.
- [Social Media Advertising Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-advertising-strategy/): Integration of paid social into broader marketing funnels.
- [Social Media Customer Service](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-customer-service/): Best practices for support and community management.
- [Customer Care Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/customer-care/): High-level approach to proactive and reactive brand care.
- [Social Media Engagement Guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-engagement/): Tactics for driving meaningful community interaction.
- [Employee Advocacy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/what-is-employee-advocacy/): Frameworks for scaling brand reach through employee networks.
- [Social Media Search (SEO)](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-search/): Optimizing social profiles and content for discovery engines.
- [Business Intelligence](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/business-intelligence/): Leveraging social data for organization-wide strategic intelligence.
- [Reputation Management](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/reputation-management/): Continuous monitoring and steering of brand sentiment.

## Analytics, Listening & Reporting
- [Social Media Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-analytics/): Comprehensive overview of social data tracking and interpretation.
- [Social Media Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-analytics-tools/): Evaluative guide of top-tier analytical software.
- [Social Media Listening](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-listening/): Methodology for industry-wide and brand-specific conversation tracking.
- [Social Listening Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-listening-tools/): Review of platforms for deep audience and trend intelligence.
- [Sentiment Analysis](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/sentiment-analysis/): Technical and strategic measurement of public perception.
- [Sentiment Analysis Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/sentiment-analysis-tools/): Software solutions for automated sentiment tracking.
- [Social Media Sentiment Analysis](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-sentiment-analysis/): Brand-specific application of sentiment tracking.
- [Social Media Metrics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-metrics/): Definitions and prioritization of essential social KPIs.
- [Social Media Reporting](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-reporting/): Best practices for translating social data into executive insights.
- [Social Media Dashboard Guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-dashboard/): Designing effective visualizations for real-time monitoring.
- [Social Media Monitoring Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-monitoring-tools/): Solutions for real-time brand mention and keyword tracking.
- [Share of Voice](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/share-of-voice/): Measuring brand visibility relative to market competitors.
- [Reach vs. Impressions](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/reach-vs-impressions/): Clarification of fundamental social distribution metrics.
- [Hashtag Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/hashtag-analytics/): Measuring the performance and reach of tagged campaigns.

## Platform Efficiency & Management
- [Social Media Management](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-management/): Core requirements for enterprise-scale social operations.
- [Social Media Management Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-management-tools/): Analysis of top-rated management platforms.
- [Social Media Scheduling Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-scheduling-tools/): Workflow optimization for content distribution.
- [Social Media Automation Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-automation-tools/): Enhancing efficiency through programmatic social tasks.
- [Social Media Calendar](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-calendar/): Strategic planning and organization of content pipelines.
- [Cross-Platform Posting](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/post-on-all-social-media-platforms-at-once/): Efficiency guide for multi-network content distribution.

## Competitive Intelligence
- [Sprout Social vs. Hootsuite](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/sprout-social-vs-hootsuite/): Detailed enterprise feature and value comparison.
- [Social Media Competitive Analysis](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-competitive-analysis/): Framework for auditing competitor social performance.
- [Competitive Analysis Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/competitive-analysis/): General business framework for market positioning.
- [Competitor Analysis Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/competitor-analysis-tools/): Software for tracking rival brand movements and data.

## Influencer Marketing
- [Influencer Marketing Guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/influencer-marketing/): Strategic framework for creator partnerships and campaigns.
- [Influencer Marketing Platforms](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/influencer-marketing-platforms/): Audit of marketplaces for connecting with creators.
- [Influencer Marketing Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/influencer-marketing-tools/): Software for managing and scaling influencer programs.
- [Influencer Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/influencer-analytics-tools/): Measuring the impact and ROI of creator partnerships.
- [How to Find Influencers](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-find-the-right-influencers/): Methodology for vettting and selecting brand-aligned creators.

## Platform-Specific Growth & Analytics

**Instagram:**
- [Instagram Marketing Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-marketing-strategy/): Full-funnel brand management for Instagram.
- [Instagram Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-analytics/): Measuring performance and audience growth on IG.
- [Instagram Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-analytics-tools/): Specialized software for deep Instagram data.
- [Instagram Metrics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-metrics/): Critical KPIs for Instagram business success.
- [Best Times to Post (Instagram)](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/best-times-to-post-on-instagram/): Data-backed peak engagement hours for IG.
- [Instagram Engagement Rate](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-engagement-rate/): Benchmarks and optimization for IG interaction.
- [Instagram Competitor Report](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-competitors-report/): Auditing rival brand performance on Instagram.
- [Instagram Stats](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-stats/): Key platform usage and growth data.
- [Instagram Reels & Hashtags](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-reel-hashtags/): Optimization for short-form video discovery.
- [Instagram Hashtags](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-hashtags/): Strategic use of tags for reach and categorization.
- [Instagram Carousel Guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-carousel/): Leveraging multi-slide posts for higher engagement.

**TikTok:**
- [TikTok Marketing](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/tiktok-marketing/): Brand building and algorithm optimization for TikTok.
- [TikTok Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/tiktok-analytics/): Understanding performance metrics on short-form video.
- [TikTok Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/tiktok-analytics-tools/): Software for tracking TikTok growth and trends.
- [Best Times to Post (TikTok)](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/best-times-to-post-on-tiktok/): Identifying the viral windows for TikTok distribution.
- [TikTok Hashtags](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/tiktok-hashtags/): Discovery optimization via TikTok-specific tagging.

**Facebook:**
- [Facebook Marketing Strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-marketing-strategy/): Management and growth for business Pages.
- [Facebook Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-analytics/): Measuring reach and engagement on the Meta ecosystem.
- [Facebook Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-analytics-tools/): Solutions for tracking Facebook Page performance.
- [Best Times to Post (Facebook)](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/best-times-to-post-on-facebook/): Peak engagement data for Facebook audiences.
- [Facebook Reach Optimization](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-reach/): Strategies for overcoming algorithm-based reach decline.
- [Facebook Competitor Analysis](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-competitor-analysis-report/): Benchmarking against rival Facebook Pages.

**LinkedIn:**
- [LinkedIn Marketing](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-marketing/): B2B brand building and professional thought leadership.
- [LinkedIn Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-analytics/): Performance tracking for personal and Page profiles.
- [LinkedIn Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-analytics-tools/): Specialized software for LinkedIn data.
- [LinkedIn Algorithm](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-algorithm/): How to optimize content for professional feed distribution.
- [LinkedIn Hashtags](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-hashtags/): Strategic tagging for B2B discovery.
- [LinkedIn Hashtag Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/linkedin-hashtag-analytics/): Measuring the reach of professional campaign tags.

**Twitter (X) & YouTube:**
- [Twitter Marketing](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/twitter-marketing/): Real-time brand engagement and news distribution.
- [Twitter Analytics](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/twitter-analytics/): Monitoring growth and tweet performance.
- [Twitter Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/twitter-analytics-tools/): Software for managing X data.
- [Twitter Monitoring Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/twitter-monitoring-tools/): Real-time mention and sentiment tracking on X.
- [YouTube Marketing](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/youtube-marketing/): Video strategy and channel growth framework.
- [YouTube Analytics Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/youtube-analytics-tools/): Tracking performance and audience retention on YT.
- [Promote YouTube Channel](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-promote-your-youtube-channel/): Multi-channel growth strategies for video content.

## Optional
- [Social Media in Healthcare](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-in-healthcare/): Industry-specific compliance and patient care strategies.
- [How to Get Followers on Instagram](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-get-followers-on-instagram/): Basic tactical guide for account growth.
- [How to Get More Views on TikTok](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-get-more-views-on-tiktok/): Entry-level optimization for TikTok visibility.
- [How to Get More Followers on TikTok](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-get-more-followers-on-tiktok/): Growth tactics for new TikTok accounts.
- [How to Make Money on TikTok](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-make-money-on-tiktok/): Monetization strategies for creators and brands.
- [How to Get Verified on Facebook](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-get-verified-on-facebook/): Process guide for account authentication.
- [UK Influencer Market Report](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/uk-influencers/): Niche regional data for the United Kingdom.
- [Social Media Image Sizes](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-image-sizes-guide/): Technical specifications for visual content.
- [Social Media Video Specs](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-video-specs-guide/): Formatting requirements for all major platforms.
- [What is Hashtagging?](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/what-is-hashtagging/): Beginner's guide to the mechanics of social tags.
- [Types of Social Media Content](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/types-of-social-media-content/): Introductory overview of social post formats.
- [Online Reputation Management Tools](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/online-reputation-management-tools/): Software for managing digital brand presence.
